concerns.text: FR-002 mandates handling missing environmental values by 'flagging or imputing with documented defaults'. Task T015 implements strict 'exclusion' and explicitly forbids imputation. While the Plan justifies this correction, the task list lacks a corresponding task to update FR-002 in the spec or formally document the spec amendment, leaving the spec requirement unmet by the current task set.

FR-004 mandates data augmentation via 'bond rotation and atom masking'. Task T025b implements 'functional-group-preserving edge dropout' and explicitly forbids bond rotation. Similar to FR-002, the task list executes a Plan correction without a task to formally amend FR-004 in the spec, creating a gap where the spec requirement is not satisfied by the defined tasks.

FR-006 mandates a permutation test on 'input features (shuffling motifs)'. Task T037 implements shuffling only for 'ester bonds'. The spec requirement is broader (general input features/motifs). The task list does not include a task to implement general motif shuffling or to formally amend FR-006 to restrict the scope to ester bonds only.

SC-005 requires verifying ester bonds are in the top '[deferred]' of attribution scores. Task T030 hardcodes the threshold to '10' based on a 'Plan Correction'. The Plan.md provided in the inputs does not contain a specific value of '10' (it only references resolving the [deferred] placeholder). There is no task to formally resolve this deferred value in the spec or plan before hardcoding it in the implementation, violating the 'deferred' convention.

Constitution Principle VI mandates validation using the 'χ² statistical test'. Task T038 implements a 'χ² Discretization Protocol' as a 'complementary' test while designating the 'Motif-Masking Permutation Test' (T037) as 'primary'. The task list lacks a task to formally amend Constitution Principle VI to reflect this methodological shift, leaving the constitutional requirement technically unmet by the primary validation path.

Task T025b references 'Plan Correction' and 'Plan: Methodological Corrections' sections that are not explicitly present in the provided plan.md text (which only lists 'Complexity Tracking' and 'Assumptions'). The task description relies on external context not visible in the artifact, making the traceability unclear.

Task T030 states the value '10' is derived from 'Plan: Methodological Corrections'. The provided plan.md does not contain a section with this exact title or the specific value '10'. This is a stale or hallucinated reference in the task description.
